en: why production is below target
production analysis screen
hi: प्रोडक्शन टारगेट से कम क्यों है
hg: production target se kam kyu hai
production analysis kya hai

a.en: Production Analysis shows how far this week's pieces made are from the weekly target, how many karigars the target needs, and which days, people and problems held the week back.
a.hi: Production Analysis बताता है इस हफ़्ते बने पीस हफ़्ते के टारगेट से कितने दूर हैं, टारगेट के लिए कितने कारीगर चाहिए, और किन दिनों, लोगों और दिक्कतों ने हफ़्ता पीछे रखा।
a.hg: Production Analysis batata hai is hafte bane pieces hafte ke target se kitne door hain, target ke liye kitne karigar chahiye, aur kin dino, logon aur dikkaton ne hafta peeche rakha.

en: change weekly target
weekly target 20000
hg: weekly target kaise badle
target 20000 kyu hai

a.en: Type the figure in Weekly target (20,000 if left empty) and pick Per-day average from this week or from the last 4 weeks.
a.hi: Weekly target में आँकड़ा लिखें (खाली छोड़ें तो 20,000) और Per-day average from this week या from the last 4 weeks चुनें।
a.hg: Weekly target mein figure likhiye (khaali chhodein to 20,000) aur Per-day average from this week ya from the last 4 weeks chuniye.

en: how many karigars needed for target
how many people to hit 20000
hi: टारगेट के लिए कितने कारीगर चाहिए
hg: target ke liye kitne karigar chahiye
kitne log chahiye 20000 ke liye

a.en: See the card How many karigars … needs: one karigar's week is pieces per karigar per day × 6, the external teams' output is taken off the target, and the rest is divided by one karigar's week.
a.hi: How many karigars … needs कार्ड देखें: एक कारीगर का हफ़्ता = प्रति कारीगर प्रति दिन पीस × 6, टारगेट में से बाहरी टीमों का काम घटाया जाता है, और बाकी को एक कारीगर के हफ़्ते से भाग दिया जाता है।
a.hg: How many karigars … needs card dekhiye: ek karigar ka hafta = per karigar per day pieces × 6, target mein se bahar ki teams ka kaam ghataya jata hai, aur baaki ko ek karigar ke hafte se bhaag diya jata hai.

en: contractor has many people under one name
set team size
hi: एक नाम के नीचे कई लोग
hg: ek naam ke neeche kai log kaam karte
team size kaise dale

a.en: Click the number in the People column for that name, enter People and From (date), and press Save; their pieces are then shared across that many people.
a.hi: उस नाम के People कॉलम के नंबर पर क्लिक करें, People और From (तारीख) भरें, और Save दबाएँ; फिर उनके पीस उतने लोगों में बँटेंगे।
a.hg: Us naam ke People column ke number par click kijiye, People aur From (date) bhariye, aur Save dabaiye; phir unke pieces utne logon mein bantenge.

en: what is look into card
karigar got no work this week
hg: look into card kya hai
karigar ko kaam nahi mila

a.en: Look into lists what held the week back: karigars who got no work, karigars sitting on work, idle contractors, empty-handed days, attendance not marked, pieces with no rate, and rejection.
a.hi: Look into में वो बातें हैं जिनसे हफ़्ता पीछे रहा: जिन कारीगरों को काम नहीं मिला, जो काम लेकर बैठे हैं, खाली ठेकेदार, खाली हाथ के दिन, हाज़िरी न लगना, बिना रेट के पीस, और रिजेक्शन।
a.hg: Look into mein woh baatein hain jinse hafta peeche raha: jin karigaron ko kaam nahi mila, jo kaam lekar baithe hain, khaali contractor, khaali haath ke din, hajri na lagna, bina rate ke pieces, aur rejection.

en: what is a karigar day
days with work how counted
hg: karigar din kya hai
days with work kaise gine jate

a.en: A working day is any day of the week with some cutting, issue or receipt entered; a karigar-day is one person on a working day on which that name had pieces in hand or was given some — and Per person per day = …
a.hi: काम का दिन हफ़्ते का वह दिन है जिसमें कोई कटिंग, इशू या रिसीव दर्ज हो; कारीगर-दिन एक व्यक्ति का वह काम का दिन है जिसमें उस नाम के पास पीस थे या उसे दिए गए — और Per person per day = बने पीस ÷ (काम वाले दिन × उस …
a.hg: Kaam ka din hafte ka woh din hai jisme koi cutting, issue ya receive darj ho; karigar-din ek vyakti ka woh kaam ka din hai jisme us naam ke paas piece the ya use diye gaye — aur Per person per day = bane piece …

en: who counts as a karigar in production analysis
salaried stitchers not in figures why
hi: Production Analysis में कारीगर किसे मानते हैं
hg: production analysis me karigar kise mante
salary wale stitcher figure me kyu nahi

a.en: A karigar is a piece-rate person in a stitching department on the employee list; Company Role stitchers are salaried and their pieces are not in the Job Work Register, so they are left out, and External contractor tea…
a.hi: कारीगर वह है जो कर्मचारी लिस्ट में सिलाई विभाग में पीस-रेट पर है; Company Role वाले सैलरी पर हैं और उनके पीस Job Work Register में नहीं होते, इसलिए छोड़े जाते हैं, और External contractor की टीम अलग दिखती है और रोज़ के…
a.hg: Karigar woh hai jo employee list mein stitching department mein piece-rate par hai; Company Role wale salary par hain aur unke piece Job Work Register mein nahi hote, isliye chhode jate hain, aur External contractor k…

en: what does more karigars needed mean
enough karigars not enough pieces a day meaning
hg: more karigars needed ka matlab
enough karigars not enough pieces a day ka matlab

a.en: The verdict is one of three: Target reached; N more karigar(s) needed when the target needs more company contractors than worked; or Enough karigars — not enough pieces a day, when there were enou…
a.hi: नतीजा तीन में से एक होता है: Target reached; N more karigar(s) needed जब टारगेट के लिए जितने company contractor चाहिए उससे कम ने काम किया; या Enough karigars — not enough pieces a day, जब लोग पूरे…
a.hg: Nateeja teen mein se ek hota hai: Target reached; N more karigar(s) needed jab target ke liye jitne company contractor chahiye usse kam ne kaam kiya; ya Enough karigars — not enough pieces a day, …

en: weekly target different on another computer
production analysis target reset to 20000
hi: दूसरे कंप्यूटर पर weekly target अलग क्यों
hg: dusre computer pe weekly target alag kyu
target wapas 20000 kyu ho gaya

a.en: The Weekly target on Production Analysis is kept only in this browser — another computer, phone or browser shows its own figure, or 20,000 if nothing was typed there; the Dashboard's % uses the same browser fig…
a.hi: Production Analysis का Weekly target सिर्फ़ इसी ब्राउज़र में रहता है — दूसरा कंप्यूटर, फ़ोन या ब्राउज़र अपना नंबर दिखाता है, या वहाँ कुछ न लिखा हो तो 20,000; डैशबोर्ड का % भी इसी ब्राउज़र का नंबर लेता है।
a.hg: Production Analysis ka Weekly target sirf isi browser mein rehta hai — doosra computer, phone ya browser apna number dikhata hai, ya wahan kuch na likha ho to 20,000; Dashboard ka % bhi isi browser ka number le…

en: got no work vs sat on work vs not worked for a month
how does app decide karigar is idle
hi: got no work, sat on work और not worked for a month में फ़र्क
hg: got no work sat on work aur not worked for a month me farak
app kaise decide karta karigar khali hai

a.en: In Look into: "got no work" = no issue or receipt this week but worked in the 4 weeks before; "sat on work" = held pieces from before and returned none; "not worked for a month" = nothing in the last 4 weeks ei…
a.hi: Look into में: "got no work" = इस हफ़्ते कोई इशू या रिसीव नहीं पर पिछले 4 हफ़्तों में काम किया; "sat on work" = पहले के पीस पास थे और कुछ नहीं लौटाया; "not worked for a month" = पिछले 4 हफ़्तों में भी कुछ नहीं;…
a.hg: Look into mein: "got no work" = is hafte koi issue ya receive nahi par pichle 4 hafton mein kaam kiya; "sat on work" = pehle ke piece paas the aur kuch nahi lautaya; "not worked for a month" = pichle 4 hafton m…

title.en: Set how many people work under a name
title.hi: किसी नाम के नीचे कितने लोग काम करते हैं, लगाना
title.hg: Kisi naam ke neeche kitne log kaam karte hain, lagana

steps.en: Some names are a team — a contractor with his own people. Let's set how many, so their pieces are shared across them.
steps.hi: कुछ नाम एक टीम हैं — अपने लोगों वाला ठेकेदार। चलिए गिनती लगाते हैं, ताकि उनके पीस उतने लोगों में बँटें।
steps.hg: Kuch naam ek team hain — apne logon wala contractor. Chaliye ginti lagate hain, taaki unke piece utne logon mein bantein.

steps.en: Find the name: type it in Search karigar / department.
steps.hi: नाम ढूँढें: Search karigar / department में लिखें।
steps.hg: Naam dhoondhiye: Search karigar / department mein likhiye.

steps.en: On the name's line, click the number in the People column.
steps.hi: नाम की लाइन पर People कॉलम का नंबर क्लिक करें।
steps.hg: Naam ki line par People column ka number click kijiye.

steps.en: Type People — how many work under this name.
steps.hi: People लिखें — इस नाम के नीचे कितने लोग काम करते हैं।
steps.hg: People likhiye — is naam ke neeche kitne log kaam karte hain.

steps.en: From is this week's Sunday. Earlier weeks keep the size they had.
steps.hi: From में इस हफ़्ते का रविवार है। पहले के हफ़्ते अपनी पुरानी गिनती रखते हैं।
steps.hg: From mein is hafte ka Sunday hai. Pehle ke hafte apni purani ginti rakhte hain.

steps.en: Press Save. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: Save दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Save dabaiye. Ye asli mein save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — the People number is updated and the per-karigar figures are worked out again. 🎉
steps.hi: हो गया — People का नंबर बदल गया और हर कारीगर के आँकड़े फिर से निकल गए। 🎉
steps.hg: Ho gaya — People ka number badal gaya aur har karigar ke figures phir se nikal gaye. 🎉
